title: Read results honestly
summary: A Jenkins result reports the configured pipeline outcome. Useful reports explain what was actually checked and what still needs review.
introduction: A Jenkins result reports the configured pipeline outcome. Useful reports explain what was actually checked and what still needs review. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not confuse a successful demonstration echo with a real test suite.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
